pythonFunction.name: enter_node
pythonFunction.description:
Traverses the deterministic flow programmatically tracking state and resolving decision trees.

Args:
    node_id: The target node ID to transition to.
    flow_id: The ID of the target/current flow.
    set_variables: A map of extracted session variables to write to state (pass empty dict if none).

Returns:
    The execution results including current_flow_id, current_node_id, accumulated_instructions, action_results, and available_intent_transitions.
